title: Incident Telemetry Companion Cards: compact telemetry + postmortem shortcuts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, attachable telemetry card that surfaces the most relevant incident signals directly inside alert and incident views. The companion cards should provide quick context (error rate delta, tail latency spike, affected routes, cost delta) and one-click links to on-call handoff snippets and postmortem templates. Target: reduce time-to-context for responders and make postmortem creation discoverable from the incident surface.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype shows a card that can attach to alerts and incidents without shifting main timeline layout
Card exposes 3 prioritized metrics and a 1-line cause hypothesis powered by recent error traces
One-click actions: copy handoff snippet, open postmortem draft, jump to related dashboard + GitHub PR
Cards are keyboard navigable and have accessible color contrast for status indicators
Design tokens and spacing match console core components; ready for implementation handoff
design_notes: We prioritize signal density: show delta + baseline instead of raw volumes to reduce cognitive load
Default metric set: error rate delta (1m/5m), p95 latency delta (1m/5m), top failing endpoint, cost delta (24h)
Compact mode collapses metric list into a sparkline row to preserve vertical space in incident lists
Handoff snippet is templated: incident summary, detected-at, top signal snapshot, recommended next steps, links to dashboards and PRs
Mobile / narrow breakpoint: card becomes an expandable row so timeline remains scannable
decisions: Show deltas instead of absolutes to make cards useful for noisy tenants (decision logged 2026-02-17)
Expose a single primary CTA (Open postmortem draft) and secondary actions in an action menu
Avoid embedding full traces to keep rendering cheap; link out to trace viewer (ENG-8891 handles trace link API)
Use existing console badge color palette for Status (ok/warning/critical) to remain consistent with SLO visuals
